Share a file: anyone with its link opens it in the hosted viewer, and downloads the files that made it (the link's .zip, which `cad import` writes into a folder), with no sign-in, until 7 days after its last share. FILE is a CAD file the viewer opens, or a document id; a model is shared by its .xbf. What goes is the file, the files that made it -- a model's script, the modules of its project that it imports and the files it reads, as its .xbf records them (run it again after an edit); a robot description's mesh files; a KiCad board's or schematic's project file, local libraries, 3D models and sheets -- and its view: its shapes as meshes with their names, measurements and joints, a board's layers and its parts' 3D models, a schematic's sheets. Never an installed library. Sharing it again keeps the link and sends only what changed. The first share on a computer needs the person's yes (--yes). `status` says whether sharing is on and lists this computer's live shares; `on` and `off` turn it on and off; `delete` removes a share.
a CAD file the viewer opens (a model's .xbf; a folder has no bundle to share), or a document id; or status, on, off or delete
after delete: the file this computer shared, or a share's delete link
share: the person agrees to sharing, kept for this computer; delete: delete without asking. Where nobody can be asked (an agent, a pipe, --json) neither runs without it

Show or change the usage stats and crash reports cad sends from CAD's apps (the CAD app in an agent app, and the viewer) and its build daemon. Never file names, paths, contents or prompts.

cad installs every newer release of its major version by itself, and a new major version only when you run `cad update --major`. `cad update` updates cad now to the newest release of its major version, even with automatic updates off: cad asks PyPI and, once nothing is running, installs it. A cad server that was running starts again; with none running, none is started. `cad update auto` shows or changes whether cad updates itself.

A new major version never installs itself: `cad update --major` installs it. On by default, for a global install (`uv tool install cad`).
